scenes.name: INSIDE THE SHEET
lines: Imagine living inside a flat sheet: every arrow you can draw lies in it.
想象你住在一张平平的薄片里：你能画出的每一支箭头，都躺在薄片之内。
So here is the question: from inside, can you point to the sheet's own up?
于是问题来了：从里面，你能指出薄片自己的“上”吗？

scenes.name: STEP OUTSIDE
lines: Now place the sheet in a three-dimensional room.
现在把薄片放进一间三维的房间。
One new arrow stands straight up, at right angles to both cyan arrows.
一支新箭头笔直立起，与两支青色箭头都成直角。
That arrow, the normal, names the whole sheet at once, and it comes from outside.
这支箭头就是法线：它一下子指认出整张薄片，而它来自薄片之外。

scenes.name: ONE MORE DIRECTION
lines: Try the same move on the whole room: inside it, there is no fourth arrow.
对整间房间做同样的事：在房间里面，已经没有第四根箭头。
We cannot draw four dimensions, so step down one: a circle in a plane.
四维画不出来，那就退一维：平面里的一个圆。
Add one new direction, and the circle becomes the sphere's middle belt, its equator.
添上一个新方向，这个圆就成了一颗球腰间的那一圈，也就是赤道。
The radius stays one: bigger means one more direction, not a longer radius.
半径仍是 1：“更大”是多了一个方向，不是半径变长。

scenes.name: ONE AXIS
lines: Stand on one axis, and read how far each direction points along it: its cosine.
站在一根轴上，读出每个方向沿这根轴指出去多少：也就是夹角的余弦。
The north pole reads one; the south pole reads the opposite.
北极读出 1；南极读出相反的 −1。
The whole equator reads zero: from this axis, it is a blind ring.
整条赤道读出的都是 0：从这根轴看，它是一圈盲区。

scenes.name: AVERAGE EVERYTHING
lines: Now give up every special direction, and mix them all equally.
现在放弃一切特殊方向，把所有方向等量混合。
Opposite arrows cancel in pairs, and the average falls to the centre.
相反的箭头两两抵消，平均落回球心。
There sits the state that leans nowhere; its matrix is half the identity.
那里是不偏向任何方向的态；它的矩阵是单位矩阵的一半。
Mixing only pulls inward: a state's arrow is never longer than one.
混合只会往里收：一个态的箭头，长度永远不超过 1。
That bound is checked by the Lean kernel.
这个上界由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: RECAP
lines: From inside, no: to name a whole, you need one more direction.
从里面指不出：要把整体指认出来，需要多一个方向。
The old sphere becomes the equator of a new one, and the radius stays one.
旧球成为新球的赤道，半径仍是 1。
Average every direction, and you land at the centre, the state that leans nowhere.
把所有方向平均，就落回球心：不偏向任何方向的态。
The book hears an echo of Gödel here: an analogy; the exact theorems come in chapter twenty-one.
本书在这里听见哥德尔的回声：这是类比；严格的定理在第 21 章。
Next in the prelude: a ruler that measures itself.
序曲下一部：量自己的尺子。
